title: Merge Two Score Lists
statement: Two teams each have a list of scores sorted in ascending order. Return one list with all scores, still in ascending order, without sorting again.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers, one per list, always taking the smaller front value
keyPoints: i = 0 in the first list, j = 0 in the second
Append the smaller of a[i] and b[j] and move that pointer
When one list ends, append the rest of the other
edgeCases: One list much longer than the other
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Concatenate and sort: O((n + m) log(n + m))

hints: Sorting again ignores that both lists are already sorted. Where is the smallest remaining score?
It is at the front of one of the two lists: compare a[i] and b[j].
Do not forget the leftover scores when one list runs out.
